_comment: The ONE place go.py picks params. preset.<name> = v1 params when that preset's bundle is used. new_variant = params on a bundle built on the day (holdem_like: 2 hole cards, any 5 of 7; other: everything else). heuristic_v0 = params for the heuristic-tables v0 (rules engine). Nov 6: per-variant cand_* winners vs ev_t3 (bench/variants_upgrade/CONFIRM.md): plo4/shortdeck/plo5/royal confirmed at 1500 SNGs (+7.3% to +8.7%), holdem3/shortdeck_triton screened at 800 SNGs (+9.8%, +8.5%); no losing cell. new_variant_no_range_net = params for <tag>_v1, the day-built bundle before its range net exists (kit2 A/B: ev_t3 there was -9.3% vs v0, the rules engine +1.8%).
